columns_never_fillable.reason: Cards disclose Gross Floor Area (GFA) and Net Lettable Area (NLA) only; no separate gross-lettable-area (GLA) figure is disclosed. GFA->gfa, NLA->nla; gla left null per GLA!=GFA invariant.

Per-property top tenants are not broken out per mall; only a portfolio Top-10 tenant list (page 57) and a portfolio trade-mix (page 63) are disclosed. The two master-leased malls (Xining, Dalian) have a single named master lessee, captured.
No FFO/AFFO disclosed; the trust reports income available for distribution (S$1.638m) instead -> performance.net_distributable_income.
No perpetual securities in the capital structure.

data_with_no_home: Independent valuation headline (page 5/62): RMB 4,694.0 million (100%); RMB 3,691.2 million on 60% interest of Beijing Wanliu. SGD consolidated audited valuation = S$859,162,000 (Portfolio Statement, page 131).
Portfolio totals: Gross Floor Area 311,691 sqm; Net Lettable Area 179,603 sqm; No. of leases 739 (page 62).
WALE 2.2 years by gross rental income; 4.2 years by NLA (page 62).
Average cost of debt 4.2% p.a. (5.0% incl. amortisation of loan establishment fee); weighted average term to maturity 2.3 years (page 61).
Borrowings: two onshore RMB facilities (RMB 192.5m and RMB 104.5m, total ~S$63.4m) + offshore S$252.0m facility; total drawn S$305.4m; >80% denominated in SGD (page 61).

NLA-by-trade-sector breakdown (page 63): Fashion & Accessories 33.2%, F&B 23.4%, Leisure & Entertainment 19.4%, Kids' Education & Retail 12.2%, Supermarket 6.5%, Beauty & Healthcare 5.3% (trade_mix captured on the GRI basis instead).

Non-controlling interest: 40% NCI in Beijing Hualian Wanmao Shopping Mall Management Co., Ltd. (the entity holding Beijing Wanliu); NCI net assets S$161,700,000; NCI total return after tax S$3,327,000 (note 15, page 169).
Audit fees S$454,000; non-audit services nil (page 174 note 19 / corporate governance page 47).
parsing_traps: Dual-currency Portfolio Statement (page 131): RMB'000 and S$'000 printed side by side for the SAME asset - do NOT add. Canonical market_valuation = SGD consolidated column (x1000); RMB preserved in properties[]._rmb_valuation_000.
Two FX rates: closing rate for valuation vs average rate for income (China retail REIT reporting SGD on RMB underlying).
Beijing Wanliu consolidated at 100% in the Portfolio Statement and financial-review tables despite 60% trust ownership (40% NCI) -> flagged full_consolidation_partial_ownership.
Per-property gross_revenue and net_property_income taken from the audited financial-review tables in S$'000 (pages 58-59), which are more precise than the rounded card values (pages 64-65).
Valuation fee on the Statement of Total Return is a credit (+22) not a charge; carried as a signed adjustment line item.

reconciliation.gross_revenue_note: Sum of the six per-property gross revenues from the financial-review table (33,069+11,569+4,069+2,983+1,912+1,504 = 55,106k in S$'000) reconciles exactly to total gross revenue S$55,106,000.
reconciliation.npi_note: Sum of per-property NPI (19,892+5,231+62+802+1,675+1,368 = 29,030k) reconciles exactly to total NPI S$29,030,000.
reconciliation.valuation_note: Sum of six properties' SGD Portfolio-Statement valuations (458,866+131,785+107,807+88,039+45,942+26,723 = 859,162k) reconciles exactly to audited 'Investment properties, at valuation' S$859,162,000. RMB sum 4,694,000k matches the RMB 4,694.0m headline.
reconciliation.line_items_recon: Sum(revenue) 55,106 - Sum(expense) 28,194 + Sum(adjustment, signed) -25,403 = 1,509 = net_income (Total return for the year after taxation). PASS.
